Dialogue: 0,0:00:00.40,0:00:02.00,Default,,0,0,0,,Hello friends, story time.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:03.40,0:00:08.60,Default,,0,0,0,,One sunny morning, Kavin the little\Nelephant walked to the big mango tree.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:08.60,0:00:11.00,Default,,0,0,0,,The mangoes glowed like little suns.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:11.00,0:00:16.60,Default,,0,0,0,,Kavin lifted his trunk up high and picked\Nthe biggest, sweetest mango of all.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:18.00,0:00:22.40,Default,,0,0,0,,"This mango is all mine," Kavin said with\Na happy smile.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:22.40,0:00:24.80,Default,,0,0,0,,He sat down under the tree.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:24.80,0:00:30.00,Default,,0,0,0,,Just then, Mittu the parrot flew down and\Nlanded on a low branch.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:31.40,0:00:33.00,Default,,0,0,0,,"What a lovely mango!"
Dialogue: 0,0:00:33.00,0:00:33.80,Default,,0,0,0,,said Mittu.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:33.80,0:00:35.80,Default,,0,0,0,,"I am so hungry today."
Dialogue: 0,0:00:35.80,0:00:37.80,Default,,0,0,0,,Kavin held the mango close.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:37.80,0:00:40.20,Default,,0,0,0,,He did not want to share.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:40.20,0:00:44.60,Default,,0,0,0,,Mittu looked down at her little feet and\Nsaid nothing more.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:46.00,0:00:49.60,Default,,0,0,0,,Then Chinnu the squirrel came running\Nalong the path.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:49.60,0:00:52.40,Default,,0,0,0,,Her tummy made a funny rumbling sound.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:52.40,0:00:56.80,Default,,0,0,0,,"I could not find any nuts this morning,"\NChinnu said softly.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:58.20,0:01:00.20,Default,,0,0,0,,Kavin looked at his friends.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:00.20,0:01:01.40,Default,,0,0,0,,Mittu was quiet.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:01.40,0:01:03.00,Default,,0,0,0,,Chinnu was quiet too.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:03.00,0:01:08.90,Default,,0,0,0,,The big mango felt heavy in his trunk, and\Nsomehow Kavin did not feel happy
Dialogue: 0,0:01:08.90,0:01:09.60,Default,,0,0,0,,anymore.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:10.80,0:01:13.60,Default,,0,0,0,,Grandpa Tortoise walked slowly up the\Nhill.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:13.60,0:01:15.60,Default,,0,0,0,,"Hello, little ones," he said.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:15.60,0:01:17.60,Default,,0,0,0,,"Kavin, a mango tastes sweet.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:17.60,0:01:20.80,Default,,0,0,0,,But do you know what tastes even sweeter?"
Dialogue: 0,0:01:22.20,0:01:23.80,Default,,0,0,0,,Kavin thought and thought.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:23.80,0:01:26.20,Default,,0,0,0,,Then he smiled a big smile.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:26.20,0:01:32.20,Default,,0,0,0,,He broke the mango into four pieces, one\Nfor Mittu, one for Chinnu, one for
Dialogue: 0,0:01:32.20,0:01:34.60,Default,,0,0,0,,Grandpa Tortoise and one for himself.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:36.00,0:01:39.20,Default,,0,0,0,,The friends sat together in the cool\Nshade.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:39.20,0:01:42.80,Default,,0,0,0,,They ate their mango pieces and laughed\Nand laughed.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:42.80,0:01:47.20,Default,,0,0,0,,Mittu sang a happy song, and Chinnu did a\Nlittle dance.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:48.60,0:01:51.00,Default,,0,0,0,,Kavin felt warm and bright inside.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:51.00,0:01:53.40,Default,,0,0,0,,"Sharing makes everyone happier," he said.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:53.40,0:01:55.40,Default,,0,0,0,,Grandpa Tortoise nodded and smiled.
Dialogue: 0,0:01:55.40,0:01:57.80,Default,,0,0,0,,Be kind, be brave, be you!
